binary.note: Resolved from PATH. The user-specific absolute path is deliberately not recorded.

source_boundary.note: The clone carries no v1.18.21 tag, so neither local HEAD nor a local tag is treated as the release. All source facts are read at ad0bb6d9a3; the installed binary and live GET /doc corroborate them.

comparison_baseline.set_differences: empty in all four categories, source-to-source and source-to-live

probe_isolation.why_home: --pure plus XDG isolation is not sufficient: OpenCode also discovers skills under ~/.claude/skills, ~/.agents/skills and ~/.config/opencode/skills, which are absolute home paths. A verified --pure run without HOME redirection still loaded a host skill.
probe_isolation.why_bash_env: BASH_ENV is inherited by the engine and sourced by its bash tool, so a shell fixture captured without unsetting it contains host rc output.
